items.description: The collection of enrichment data items matching the request

_links.description: Set of URLs related to the enrichment item, includes `self` URL and `next` page URL

score.description: X out of 10 value representing enquiry enrichment score

isFinalised.description: Value indicating whether enrichment process has been completed and data is fully available

enrichedAt.description: Time that the enquiry was enriched in ISO8601 format

buyerReadiness.description: Value indicating where the consumer is in their buy journey

listingEngagement.description: Value indicating level of engagement with the listing

topSearchedConfigurationBathrooms.description: Collection of consumer's top searched bedroom configurations. If corresponding data is not available, it will be returned as an empty array (`[]`)

position.description: Number indicating the order of available search preference items

band.description: Value indicating level of consumer's interest in particular listing configuration

match.description: Value indicating whether consumer's search preference matches the listing configuration

bathrooms.description: Number of bathrooms captured as consumer's listing configuration search preference

topSearchedConfigurationBedrooms.description: Collection of consumer's top searched bathroom configurations. If corresponding data is not available, it will be returned as an empty array (`[]`)

position.description: Number indicating the order of available search preference items

band.description: Value indicating level of consumer's interest in particular listing configuration

match.description: Value indicating whether consumer's search preference matches the listing configuration

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms captured as consumer's search preference

topSearchedConstructionTypes.description: Collection of consumer's top searched construction types. If corresponding data is not available, it will be returned as an empty array (`[]`)

position.description: Number indicating the order of available search preference items

band.description: Value indicating level of consumer's interest in particular construction type

match.description: Value indicating whether consumer's search preference matches the listing construction type

constructionType.description: Construction type captured as consumer's search preference

topSearchedPropertyTypes.description: Collection of consumer's top searched property types. If corresponding data is not available, it will be returned as an empty array (`[]`)

position.description: Number indicating the order of available search preference items

band.description: Value indicating level of consumer's interest in particular property type

match.description: Value indicating whether consumer's search preference matches the listing property type

propertyType.description: Construction type captured as consumer's search preference

topSearchedSuburbs.description: Collection of consumer's top searched suburbs. If corresponding data is not available, it will be returned as an empty array (`[]`)

position.description: Number indicating the order of available search preference items

band.description: Value indicating level of consumer's interest in particular suburb

match.description: Value indicating whether consumer's search preference matches the listing location suburb

suburb.description: Suburb name captured as consumer's search preference
